toolbar.exit_immerse: Exit immerse — back to the full graph
toolbar.hide_topics: Hide topics — show the raw graph without clustering
toolbar.show_topics: Show topics — colour notes by their detected topic
toolbar.collapse_needs_topics: Turn topics on to collapse them
toolbar.expand_all: Expand all topics back into notes (S)
toolbar.collapse_all: Collapse all topics into single nodes (S) — or select topics and use Collapse

topics.heading: Topics
topics.granularity_desc: Left: a few broad topics. Right: many specific ones. Every note stays visible.
topics.granularity_desc_with_keys: Left: a few broad topics. Right: many specific ones. Every note stays visible. (↑/↓ on the graph)
topics.granularity_pending: Working out this vault's topic levels…

inferred_hint.no_index: Connect notes by meaning as well as by the links you wrote. Needs a graph embedding index — pick one in the plugin's Graph settings.
inferred_hint.hidden_still_grouping: Hidden, but still grouping notes. Toggle twice to exclude them from topics as well.
inferred_hint.off: Off — topics come from the links you wrote.
inferred_hint.off_coverage: Off — topics come from the links you wrote. Your links alone group {placed} of {total} notes ({percent}%); the other {unlinked} are unlinked.
inferred_hint.on_no_edges: Connect notes by meaning as well as by the links you wrote — needs a graph embedding index.
inferred_hint.on: Connect notes by meaning as well as by the links you wrote: {inferred} similarity connections so unlinked notes still find a topic. Turn off to see what your own links cover.

scope.heading: Scope
scope.markdown_only_desc: Show only Markdown notes; off shows all indexable files
scope.tags_desc: Draw each tag as a node linked to the notes that carry it; shared tags also help shape topics

display.heading: Display
display.topic_regions_desc: Tint the area behind each topic so groups read at a glance
display.topic_labels_desc: Show the topic name pills over the graph
display.direction_arrows_desc: Show arrows for directed wiki links
display.highlight_inferred_desc_no_index: Draw inferred links in the accent color. Needs a graph embedding index — pick one in the plugin's Graph settings.
display.highlight_inferred_desc: Draw inferred links in the accent color so they stand apart from the links you wrote
display.highlight_inferred_desc_off: Draw inferred links in the accent color. Needs Inferred links (under Topics) turned on.
display.highlight_isolated_desc: Mark notes with no wiki links in accent color
display.highlight_bridges_desc: Mark notes that connect multiple topics in accent color

selection.zoom_tooltip: Move the camera to fit the selected notes
selection.collapse_tooltip: Fold the selected topics into single nodes
selection.expand_tooltip: Unfold the selected topics back into notes
selection.immerse_tooltip: Rebuild graph with selected notes only
selection.open_in_chat_tooltip: Reveal the chat and attach the selected notes
selection.open_all_tooltip: Open all selected notes in new tabs

message.one: This opens {count} note in a new tab. Closing it again is manual.
message.other: This opens {count} notes in new tabs. Closing them again is manual.

notices.chat_not_initialized: Chat is not initialized yet. Please open a chat first.

private_titles_withheld.one: Private note titles were withheld from {count} topic. Trust the graph model's provider to include them.
private_titles_withheld.other: Private note titles were withheld from {count} topics. Trust the graph model's provider to include them.

notices.no_graph_chat_model: No graph chat model selected, so topics can't be named.

note_context.title: Context
note_context.semantic_hint: Semantic neighbors appear once a graph embedding index is configured.
